newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids rise, selling slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids rise, selling slow.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring wheat rose on Friday, keeping pace with gains in MGE spring wheat futures, but farmer selling slowed, traders said.
"We're not really seeing much business today," a Montana dealer said. "The board goes up and the farmer selling shuts down."
Farmers had let go of some wheat on Thursday after futures prices fell sharply. Merchants cited fears of further losses. But Friday's gains alleviated those concerns, they said.
Forecasts called for clearing weather next week in key spring wheat growing areas.
Merchants said some farmers hoped to begin seeding the spring wheat crop then, although fields in the flood-ravaged areas of North Dakota and Minnesota will likely still be wet.
